detailed_descriptions.en: Discover FPV flying, practice new tricks or prepare for your next real-world session. Uncrashed brings freestyle, racing and drone chase flying together in a simulator built for beginners and experienced pilots alike. Find your line, push your limits and try again without risking your drone. PHYSICS 3.0 Experience our latest flight physics model, with updated thrust and propwash simulation, improved collision stability and PID tuning to adjust your drone’s response. FIND YOUR NEXT SPOT From open parks to abandoned industrial sites, explore large and diverse official maps designed by a team with extensive FPV experience. Practice freestyle lines, train for races or follow moving vehicles through environments built to make the most of every flight. CREATE & EXPLORE Build your own flying spots and race tracks with the Environment & Track Editor, then share them on Steam Workshop. Discover community creations, including recreations of real-world bando spots, and fly places brought to life by other pilots. FLY TOGETHER Meet other pilots in multiplayer free flight or race against friends. Practice together, share your favorite spots and compete for a place on the leaderboards. BUILD YOUR DRONE Choose your frame, motors, propellers and battery, then adjust your setup to suit your flying style. Take your pick from freestyle and racing builds, or go smaller with Tiny Whoop drones. CAPTURE YOUR FLIGHTS Record your sessions with the replay system, revisit your best moments and export videos to share your flights. A radio controller is highly recommended for the full FPV experience.
